subject: Execution
notes: kb/Work PB603 (wave 1095 F). Rule (cite.py --check 14.6.11 OK, rule 2): 'An implicit CLOSE statement without any phrases is executed for each file that is in the open mode. These implicit close statements shall be executed for all open files in the run unit, even when an error occurs during the execution of one or more of the CLOSE statements. Any exception processing procedures associated with these files are not executed.' All three halves now hold and are pinned. (1) EVERY OPEN FILE, ONLY THE OPEN ONES, AS THE CLOSE STATEMENT: RunUnit.Terminate (RunMain's finally, RunUnit.Run's finally; also after abnormal termination, 14.6.12) calls FileRegistry.CloseAll, which drains the GC's pending per-object closes and then reaches every registered connector through CloseIfOpen, the CLOSE dispatch's own entry (CloseByFormat, Table 14's plain CLOSE row, SharedClose's deregistration and 9.1.16 record-lock release). It used to call each connector's Close() directly and stamped '42' on every closed sequential connector; OnlyTheCloseDispatch_CallsAConnectorsOwnClose keeps CloseByFormat the only caller of a connector's Close() in FileRegistry (Reset and CloseDisplaced were moved onto it too). (2) 'EVEN WHEN AN ERROR OCCURS': a close failure that is an I-O status ('30': IOException, UnauthorizedAccessException, OutOfMemoryException) is an ordinary completed CLOSE; a failure no status describes no longer stops the loop: CloseAll guards each close, closes every file, then rethrows (several as one AggregateException), and FileConnector.Close runs CloseCore even when the held-line drain throws and ends the file lock and the open mode in a finally, so no lock outlives the run unit. Re-probed: before the fix an injected close-time InvalidOperationException left the failing file and every later one open; after it all are closed, their records persisted, and the next run unit opens the failed file OUTPUT with '00'. RunUnit.Terminate releases static storage in a finally. (3) No exception procedure runs: CloseAll never enters the emitted CLOSE statement that selects USE declaratives, and FileConnector's Status setter raises no condition. Also witnessed by RunUnitTerminationTests.ImplicitClose_ReachesFileOpenedBySeparatelyCompiledSub and AbnormalTermination_StillClosesOpenFiles.
